title: PHP 5.6.38 Released
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 5.6.38. This is a security release. One security bug has been fixed in this release. All PHP 5.6 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 5.6.38 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
